description: Call this when you need to pick a store for a product need and want one where a saved check shows an agent reached checkout. Filters: category or q (shopper words), min_grade (optional, default none), limit (default 5). Returns total, the store hosts with checked_at and grade, and a full_list link. Each store carries its Agent Readiness Grade (grade, null when not graded). Stores whose saved checkout evidence is from the last 30 days come first (fresh_success: true), then older evidence. Within each, best current grade first (A, then B…); an expired grade ranks after current ones of the same letter; newest checked_at first within a grade. Results are ordered only by published grade and freshness, never by anything else. Pass min_grade to keep only stores with a current grade of that letter or better. Example: find_stores({"category":"running shoes","limit":3}) → {"total":12,"stores":[{"host":"…","checked_at":"…","grade":{"grade":"A",…}}],…}. A store missing from the list is not a no. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

category.description: Category or shopper words, such as footwear or running shoes.

limit.description: How many stores to return. Default 5.

min_grade.description: Optional: keep only stores whose current (not expired) Agent Readiness Grade is this letter or better (A, B, C or D; F is accepted and means any graded store, since method v2 gives no F). Default none: every store is listed. Expired and not-graded stores are left out when this is set.

q.description: Product need, such as skincare or camping gear.

name: find_stores
title: Find stores
